title: Re-review hn6: its tree changed since its READY final review (round 4)
description:
Review the epic hn6 again, AS INTEGRATED, before the run lands it: its final review (pv7, decision 48) judged it READY at fbce6fc37f64, and the epic branch has changed since — now at e361821014b8, with work that review never saw (a tick closed or a commit pushed after it). This is review round 4, made only because the tree changed; the run lands on YOUR verdict, not the earlier one.

Judge the tree as it stands: READY when the epic does what it said it would, NOT READY naming what blocks it.
